description_en: Queries the status of scaling activities that trigger text message, internal message, or email-based notifications. When you call the DescribeAlertConfiguration operation, you must specify the scaling group ID and region ID to query the status of the desired scaling activities. A scaling activity can be in one of the following states: Successful, Failed, and Rejected
description_zh: 调用DescribeAlertConfiguration接口，并指定伸缩组的ID、地域的ID，以查询伸缩组中需要发送短信、站内信和邮件通知的伸缩活动状态，例如伸缩活动执行成功、失败、被拒绝
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-alert-configuration --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAlertConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

ScaleStatuses.description_en: The status of the scaling activities that trigger text message, internal message, or email-based notifications
ScaleStatuses.description_zh: 伸缩组中设置需要发送短信、站内信和邮件通知的伸缩活动类型

items.description_en:
The status of the scaling activity that triggers text message, internal message, or email-based notifications. Valid values:

ScaleSuccessful: Notifications are sent if the scaling activity is successfully complete.
ScaleRejected: Notifications are sent if the scaling activity is rejected.
ScaleFailed: Notifications are sent if the scaling activity failed
items.description_zh:
伸缩组开启需要发送短信、站内信和邮件通知的伸缩活动类型。可能值：
ScaleSuccessful：伸缩活动执行成功时发送通知。
ScaleRejected：伸缩活动被拒绝时发送通知。
ScaleFailed：伸缩活动执行失败时发送通知
